decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch close to the core water-control offer, it is still in an early learning phase and likely worth keeping as a relatively low-cost option, though its narrower fit and weaker website prominence make withdrawal more plausible than for the others.

This product fits the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, energy-efficient infrastructure, so management would likely keep the option open because uncertainty is still resolving and the upside for cross-selling into existing projects is substantial.

A dedicated webpage and several models suggest stronger commercial commitment and good fit with the established portfolio, so under real-options logic the firm would likely continue the line while demand information accumulates.
